remarks: Welcome to Lewiston Heights Luxury Estates, one of Western New York's most prestigious communities. This exceptional homesite offers a rare opportunity to build your dream home in a picture-perfect setting near the beautiful Niagara Falls Country Club. Nestled near the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this premium lot features a stunning wooded backdrop, providing privacy, natural beauty, and an ideal setting for your custom home.  As you enter this exclusive neighborhood through its signature covered bridge, you'll immediately appreciate the charm and elegance that make Lewiston Heights unlike any other community in the area. Enjoy a walkable neighborhood just minutes from the historic Village of Lewiston, the world-class Artpark, and the scenic Niagara River.  If you've been waiting for the perfect location to build, this is your opportunity. Very few homesites remain in this highly sought-after subdivision, making this one of the last chances to become part of this extraordinary community. Don't miss the opportunity to create the home you've always envisioned in one of Lewiston's most desirable luxury locations.
